name: mujeeb
description: Mujeeb voice engine — Phase 0 local voice loop

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.dev: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/app/cli.js serve
scripts.dev:fake: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/app/cli.js serve --fake
scripts.telephony: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/app/cli.js telephony
scripts.telephony:fake: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/app/cli.js telephony --fake
scripts.probe:elevenlabs: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/app/cli.js probe-elevenlabs
scripts.report: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/app/cli.js report
scripts.seed:medplum: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/app/cli.js seed-medplum
